Our Wins

From safer streets and better transit to statewide coalition victories — here’s what we’ve accomplished together for Hudson County.

8,000+Subscribers 4Active Campaigns $25KGrants Secured 2021Founded Campaign Victories 🚉 Transit · Major Win

PATH Service Improvements Secured

After years of advocacy and mobilizing thousands of Hudson County residents, the Port Authority committed to significant PATH service improvements — a direct result of our A Better PATH campaign and the 5,000+ petition signers who demanded change.

2025 Read More 🎤 Civic Engagement

North Jersey Transit Forum

We organized the first-ever North Jersey Transit Forum, bringing together NJ TRANSIT leadership, elected officials, and hundreds of residents to build a unified vision for regional mobility — keynoted by NJ TRANSIT Chair Priya Jain.

2026 Read More 🛣️ Highway · Policy

Turnpike Expansion Stopped

Governor Sherrill chose the “One Bridge Solution” over a $10.7 billion highway expansion. As part of the Turnpike Trap coalition, HCCS helped stop a plan that would have repeated decades of failed road-widening policy.

2026 Read More 🚲 Bike Infrastructure

River Road Bike Lane Upgraded

Supported the new River Road protected bike lane–the first protected bike lane segment on a county road outside of a park!

2025 Read More 🚲 Better Buses

JFK Bus Rapid Transit Study

Secured a County commitment to study BRT on JFK.

2025 Read More 🚲 Bike Infrastructure

14th St. Viaduct Protected Path

County Executive announced that Hudson County will award a contract to design and build a shared use path on the 14th Street Viaduct.
